programs.title: The Lobster
programs.desc: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice.

programs.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
programs.desc: The battle for NINJAGO City calls to action young Master Builder Lloyd, aka the Green Ninja, along with his friends, also secret ninja warriors. Led by Master Wu, as wise-cracking as he is wise, they must defeat the evil warlord Garmadon, who also happens to be Lloyd's dad. Pitting father against son, the epic showdown tests these fierce but undisciplined modern-day ninjas as they learn to check their egos and pull together to unleash the inner power of Spinjitzu.

programs.title: Lola Versus
programs.desc: Just three weeks before her wedding, Lola (Greta Gerwig) finds herself suddenly without a partner when her longtime fiancé, Luke (Joel Kinnaman), dumps her. With her 30th birthday looming and being forced to re-enter the New York City dating scene, she feels adrift in a cold world. She leans on her friends (Zoe Lister-Jones, Hamish Linklater) for support but, after a series of romantic humiliations, professional blunders and boozy antics, Lola realizes that she alone is in charge of her fate.

programs.title: Martin Lawrence: You So Crazy
programs.desc: Filmed at a sold-out Majestic Theater in Brooklyn, N.Y., comedian Martin Lawrence delivers his first full-length stand-up special. Harking back to Eddie Murphy, the leather-clad comic riffs on drugs, jail, his impoverished upbringing with his mother and his luck -- or lack thereof -- with women. He also speaks at length about racism and the Rodney King ruling and subsequent riots. Lawrence even offers his unique perspective on how to maintain a successful relationship.

programs.title: Jerrod Carmichael: Don't Be Gay
programs.desc: Emmy-winning comedian Jerrod Carmichael takes to the stage for his latest comedy special, bringing his signature blend of unbridled honesty, emotional gut punches and sharp, dry wit.

programs.title: Jerrod Carmichael: Love at the Store
programs.desc: The comic discusses topics including poverty, wealth, crime and race in a performance at the Comedy Store in Hollywood, Calif.

programs.title: Jerrod Carmichael: Rothaniel
programs.desc: Jerrod Carmichael performs before a live audience at the legendary Blue Note Jazz Club in New York City.

programs.title: Yvonne Orji: A Whole Me
programs.desc: Orji uses therapy as a through line to discuss her thoughts on friendship, dating, adulting and why guys need better friends; Orji shows her range while also being a no-holds-barred therapy session for all.

programs.title: Zola
programs.desc: Zola, a Detroit waitress, is seduced into a weekend of stripping in Florida for some quick cash -- but the trip becomes a sleepless 48-hour odyssey involving a nefarious friend, her pimp and her idiot boyfriend.

programs.title: 2 Dope Queens
programs.desc: Jon Stewart joins the Queens to share early memories of living in New York; Phoebe and Jessica test Jon's pizza knowledge; comics Michelle Buteau, Mark Normand and Baron Vaughn.

programs.title: 2 Dope Queens
programs.desc: Phoebe and Jessica break down black hairstyles for Sarah Jessica Parker; comics Aparna Nancherla, Rhea Butcher and Sheng Wang.
